prose: Stratechery's Sharp Tech podcast is, for the first time, available on video - on YouTube, Spotify and Stratechery itself. The episode on offer covers Anthropic's S-1 and what it means for Meta and Muse, a segment titled 'You Can See Everything', and the Brewers. The article page beyond the announcement is subscriber content, so episode specifics come from the title rather than the recording.
highlights: Sharp Tech launches a video edition on YouTube, Spotify and Stratechery
Episode topics: Anthropic's S-1 and its meaning for Meta and Muse, plus 'You Can See Everything'
Full episode sits behind the Stratechery Plus subscription
